restartScenarios.title: Job queued直後に process restart
remains: Postgres path: job row with status queued (if commit completed)
File path: job in .data/work-queue.json only if persist() finished
lost: V2 run occurrence Map entries not yet durable-persisted
restartScenarios.currentOutcome: Postgres SoT → worker can lease after restart. File SoT → only same instance disk; Vercel ephemeral → job lost. Memory-only V2 enqueue → lost.
restartScenarios.requiredFix: Mandate Postgres Work Queue in production (fail-fast if unavailable); await durable run/occurrence write before ack.

restartScenarios.title: Worker running中に restart
remains: Completed steps already written via updateStep
restartScenarios.currentOutcome: After lease expiry another worker can reclaim. If external side-effect already applied but step not completed → duplicate risk on retry.
restartScenarios.requiredFix: Durable step claim + external idempotency keys before side effects; await heartbeat writes or shorten reclaim with evidence checks.

restartScenarios.title: Artifact生成後、Storage保存前に restart
remains: Possibly nothing if only __atlasDeliverableStore had the buffer
Partial DB row without storage object if mid-write
restartScenarios.currentOutcome: User/job may see memory hit then cold miss; regenerate may create second artifact. Local backend reports ok without durable bytes.
restartScenarios.requiredFix: Await durable metadata+bytes before returning success; transactional evidence linking artifactId to job/run.

restartScenarios.title: External API成功後、Evidence保存前に restart
remains: Possibly no durable evidence in job/run
restartScenarios.currentOutcome: Retry may re-post; or recovery marks failed despite external success; false completed if memory said ok without durable proof.
restartScenarios.requiredFix: Write pending_external / idempotency record BEFORE external call; store provider result ids durably before completed.

restartScenarios.title: Notification前に restart
remains: Job/run may already be completed in store
In-app notification only if append+persist completed
restartScenarios.currentOutcome: User may get job completed without push/LINE; retry notify can duplicate if not idempotent.
restartScenarios.requiredFix: Durable outbox for notification delivery; ACK/DLQ already partial — make create→outbox transactional with job completion.

restartScenarios.title: Scheduler tick中に restart
remains: Already enqueued Work Queue jobs (if durable backend)
Persisted nextRunAt if durable persist completed
lost: In-memory due list / nextRunAt advances not persisted
Tick claims only in process/global durable if write incomplete
restartScenarios.currentOutcome: Missed tick or double occurrence enqueue depending on whether occurrenceKey was durable.
restartScenarios.requiredFix: Durable occurrence reservation before enqueue; DB unique on occurrence; await nextRunAt persist.

restartScenarios.title: Memory更新直後に restart
lost: Hot Map mutations after last void persistDurableDomain
restartScenarios.currentOutcome: Recent memory writes disappear until user re-enters them; apply-log may also miss events.
restartScenarios.requiredFix: Await persist for mutating Memory APIs; optional write-ahead to atlas_user_state before ACK.

restartScenarios.title: Retry scheduled中に restart
remains: Postgres/file job with retry_at/status if update persisted
restartScenarios.currentOutcome: Durable retry_at → recovered on next drain. Memory-only → retry forever lost. Reclaim may re-run external steps.
restartScenarios.requiredFix: Forbid memory-only job store in production; durable retry_at + external idempotency.

multiInstance.title: 2 Worker同時
multiInstance.raceResult: Postgres: lease/SKIP LOCKED should serialize. File store: per-process mutex + shared JSON races → duplicate lease/lost updates. Process memory irrelevant for queue when using PG.
multiInstance.requiredFix: Production-only Postgres store; ban file fallback on multi-instance.

multiInstance.title: 2 Scheduler tick同時
multiInstance.raceResult: Each instance has its own automation Map. Without durable occurrence unique, both may enqueue same occurrence. Global durable claims help only if awaited/shared.
multiInstance.requiredFix: DB unique(occurrence_key) + claim row before enqueue; remove memory-only due lists.

multiInstance.title: 同一Job lease競合
multiInstance.raceResult: PG lease columns mediate. File store cannot safely coordinate across instances — both may believe they own the lease.
multiInstance.requiredFix: Fail-fast if Work Queue not Postgres in production.

multiInstance.title: 同一Occurrence作成
multiInstance.raceResult: V2 memory occurrenceKeys Map is per-instance → duplicate runs. Work Queue PG unique on occurrence_key blocks duplicates when used.
multiInstance.requiredFix: Move V2 occurrence index to DB unique constraint (Phase 1-2+).

multiInstance.title: 同一External Action実行
multiInstance.raceResult: Idempotency in process Map / missing provider idempotency → duplicate posts/sends across instances or retries.
multiInstance.requiredFix: Durable idempotency key + provider dedupe before external call.

multiInstance.title: 同一Notification送信
multiInstance.raceResult: In-app store is process memory until durable hydrate; two instances may create duplicate notifications / double push if delivery detached twice.
multiInstance.requiredFix: Durable notification id/outbox with unique constraint; await delivery state.

multiInstance.title: 同一Artifact生成
multiInstance.raceResult: Memory store not shared; parallel generates create distinct ids. Storage upload has some already-exists handling, but job may attach wrong/missing artifact.
multiInstance.requiredFix: Content-addressed or job-scoped unique artifact keys in DB before generate.

migrationTargets.rationale: File/memory fallback loses work on restart/multi-instance.
V2 memory Map is live SoT for runs/idempotency/occurrence.
Step progress must survive crash for safe resume.
File mutex is not multi-instance safe.
Detached heartbeat causes false stuck / double lease.

migrationTargets.targetStorage: DB unique indexes (runs, jobs, external actions)
migrationTargets.retention: TTL for ephemeral keys; permanent for external action receipts
migrationTargets.rationale: Process Map idempotency cannot prevent cross-instance duplicates.

migrationTargets.targetStorage: DB evidence columns / outbox linked to job+run
migrationTargets.rationale: Evidence must precede completed; survive restart.
Prevent duplicate side effects after crash/retry.
Due-tick memory lists miss/double across instances.
V2 occurrenceKeys Map is process-local.
Memory fallback drops retry schedules.

migrationTargets.targetStorage: DB reclaim based on lease + evidence
migrationTargets.rationale: Recovery needs durable job/lease truth.
void persist creates crash window after generate.
Detached delivery + memory hot store.
Fire-and-forget persist loses recent writes.
Process counters disappear every deploy.
Detached token persist can brick connections after refresh.
Follows Run SoT migration.

migrationTargets.targetStorage: user durable prefs domain / profile table
migrationTargets.rationale: localStorage not server SoT; multi-device inconsistent.

migrationTargets.targetStorage: keep derived; ensure underlying projects SoT is DB
migrationTargets.rationale: Fix project backend; aggregation stays computed.

migrationTargets.targetStorage: optional metrics table if product requires durable KPI
migrationTargets.rationale: Currently null-derived; no SoT to migrate yet.

recommendedOrder.reason: All completion, lease, and evidence hang off job/run/step identity. V2 memory runs + WQ file fallback are the largest loss/duplication surface.
Without durable lease truth, multi-worker reclaim doubles execution of the jobs just migrated.
DB unique keys must exist before retry/recovery is made aggressive, or duplicates increase.
Prevents false completed and external duplicates once retries are reliable.
Depends on durable job enqueue + occurrence unique; otherwise tick storms recreate work.
Safe only after evidence + idempotency exist so reclaim cannot re-fire side effects blindly.
Link artifacts to durable job/run evidence; remove void-persist crash window.
Delivery can be eventually consistent once job completion is durable and idempotent.
User value high but not on the critical external-action path; await persist after core queue SoT.
Observability and UX prefs after production work integrity is guaranteed.
